behavior: Missing documents remain absent until a mutation writes; existing invalid documents fail activation, and recognized flat documents upgrade once under the document lock.

Every operation queues behind prior settled work. A failed or abandoned caller cannot cancel an admitted durable operation or poison later mutations. All writes reconcile disk under the 30-second writer lock and commit atomically before notifying.

Read/modify results retain object identity. Missing deletes and undefined mutation results do not write or emit. External reload replaces the complete snapshot before ordered change notifications; failed reload retains the last good snapshot.
Unloading closes admission, stops the owned watcher and drains executing operations even with watch disabled. Queued mutations that have not started reject with the pinned disposal messages.
Current browser Connection initialization now awaits the credential mutation before publishing the connection. Historical synchronous provider/connection classes remain for explicit historical tests.
limitations: Native uses a Python polling watcher for Windows 7 rather than chokidar. Real creation/change/deletion and shutdown were exercised, but platform-specific native-watcher event shape is not claimed identical.
This is targeted migration evidence; the coordinated candidate, extracted Portable/browser and actual Windows 7 release qualification remain pending.
